title: PULCRA SUNT QUAE VISA PLACENT
html_source:
Once again, the Latin of:
Beautiful are those things that please the eyes

anchor.prefix:
last one that remained, saying simply:

 —Proceed!

 —Aquinas, said Stephen, says that is beautiful the apprehension of which pleases.

 Lynch nodded.

 —I remember that, he said,
